mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wecom_oauth_state (state, purpose, corp_id, user_id, target, workspace_id, expires_at, consumed_at, client_ip, created_at) VALUES (#{state}, #{purpose}, #{corpId}, #{userId}, #{target}, #{workspaceId}, #{expiresAt}, #{consumedAt}, #{clientIp}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE wecom_oauth_state SET consumed_at = NOW() WHERE state = #{state} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > NOW()
